_his_words: OK great that's a good starting point — [paul-declared 2026-09-11, on the ten-cell proposal put to him in plain terms: what the person is doing, read as whom, and whether it can walk today]
_what_a_cell_is: One pair: a JOURNEY (a path a real person takes through the product) and a LENS (the posture it is read in). The gate passes on every DECLARED cell; a declared cell with no run at this sha prints UNWALKED and the gate REFUSES, unless the change classifier says its journey cannot reach what moved AND the carried-forward pass prints its byte proof.
_why_declaring_matters: Until this file existed the exit condition was VACUOUSLY satisfied: zero declared means zero can be UNWALKED means nothing to refuse on. This is what turns 'every cell passed' from a statement about whatever happened to run into a statement about what we said we would walk.

rounds._why_declared_explicitly: Round 1 is 'all' by default if no rounds key exists. Declaring it anyway makes the FIRST round an ACT rather than a default, and makes round 2's shape visible before anyone proposes a smaller battery. The cheapest moment to establish that a round names its carried cells is before anyone wants a smaller one.
